condition.center_m: three finite JSON numbers; any fixed observation centre, not necessarily a source centre
condition.radius_m: strictly positive finite JSON number in metres
condition.physical_meaning: imaginary observation sphere; not a charged source or collision boundary

occurrence: first detected transverse root strictly after launch
initial_policy: on or numerically unresolved relative to surface is rejected; defined observation-centre launches are allowed
particle_index: zero-based integer referring to scene.particles; booleans rejected
max_step_s: duration_s/10000 <= cap <= duration_s; halved cap must be representable
min_radial_speed_m_s: strictly positive transversality threshold; not a force or velocity change

accuracy.residual: absolute radial residual and coordinate uncertainty each <= position_atol_m
accuracy.meaning: two-run agreement, not a certified error bound or completeness proof

execution.method: native DOP853 terminal events and y_events
execution.refinement: halve step cap and divide all solver tolerances by ten
execution.cache: exact validated request, excluding id; packet-local; independent of plane and saved-sample caches

no_event_meaning: no root detected in either recorded search, not proof of no crossing or touching
schema_note: Descriptive machine-readable contract, not JSON Schema. Runtime packet validation is authoritative.
